build_pipeline_init_db_connection: build a database connection using init_db_connection with Postgres credentials from pipeline valves
create_pipeline_instance: create a Pipeline instance with DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_DATABASE, DB_TABLE, OLLAMA_HOST, and TEXT_TO_SQL_MODEL valves
run_pipeline_pipe: run the pipe method with a natural language question to generate and execute a text-to-SQL query against a Postgres table
test_pipeline_on_startup: test the on_startup lifecycle hook that initializes the database connection on server startup
review_pipeline_valves: review the Pipeline.Valves Pydantic model with database and Ollama configuration fields
